method: Actual encoded MP4 decoded frames: inspect chronological 6-column by 5-row contact sheets in row-major order, frames60..89 then90..119; inspect paired source/output maps at output75 and112.

camera.observed: Map scale, northern tracking and rotation change gradually across all60 reviewed frames. The advancing interface and actor groups remain in a stable central attention band. No hard cut, jump, black rotation corner or visible map/territory projection separation.
camera.referenceComparison: Northern coast and major country silhouette substantially align in both viewed comparisons. Exact geographic/coastline parity is limited by source GIS simplification and fit accuracy.
camera.C1Evidence: Pure adapter focused tests verify shared roll velocity; this visual review corroborates smoothness but does not measure C1 from image pixels.

territory.observed: Bright gained Purple area expands while Orange recedes. No whole-screen repaint, rectangular band or gain disconnected from the land silhouette was seen in these60frames.
territory.remainingGap: Candidate front is smoother and less finely jagged than reference; west coast and islands are simplified by unchanged original country geometry.

combat.observed: Three northern badges and five southern badges preserve reference grouping and national-flag identity. Unit movement remains attached to corresponding front geography, without visible snap/disappearance in these60frames.
combat.remainingGap: Candidate uses simplified procedural soldier portraits; facial, helmet and uniform detail differs visibly from the reference.

map.remainingGap: Candidate mainland is darker olive and notably softer/lower-detail; orange ownership has weaker terrain relief. Ocean is more uniform and coastline/island detail is coarser. Actual side-by-side comparisons do not establish reference-level terrain/ocean appearance.

colorClarity.observed: Orange opposing territory, intense gained Purple and darker prior Purple are distinct at contact-sheet mobile scale. Badge flags remain identifiable. No decorative arrow, route trace or added frontier stroke was visible in this interval.
colorClarity.remainingGap: Foreground brightness and background detail/contrast still differ from reference.
